g.text: RDC ACETONE EXTRACTION VER 1 · OTS (ISSUED FOR TEACHING)
ACETONE EXTRACTION WITH 1,1,2-TCE · ROTATING-DISC CONTACTOR C-101
1. Flows in kg/h; temperatures in °C; pressures in bar g. Values: simulator design point (noise off).
2. Stream numbers are PFD numbers (Turton); the BFD numbers are given on the PFD tab.
3. Utility: chw chilled water 8 °C. Only the control valves that define the process are shown.
4. T-101 and D-102 are N2-blanketed; T-101 vents through a PVRV with flame arrester (HAZOP R-02, EQ-01).
